collection.description: A villager fashions a tiny sail from a fallen petal.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1) fashions a tiny sail from a fallen petal. (Name1) had expected to win and is surprised not to mind losing.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1) fashions a tiny sail from a fallen petal. A passing breeze changes everyone's predictions.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1) fashions a tiny sail from a fallen petal. The smallest boat travels farthest, provoking delighted disbelief.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1) fashions a tiny sail from a fallen petal. Nobody wants the game to end, even when supper is called.
